projectDescription: A fully-featured, high-performance terminal emulator component for the browser and Node.js, powering terminals in VS Code, Hyper, and hundreds of other applications.
keyFeatures: Full VT100/VT220/xterm escape sequence support including mouse events
Optional GPU-accelerated WebGL renderer for high-performance rendering
Rich Unicode support — CJK, emojis, IME, grapheme clustering
Extensible addon architecture for clipboard, search, image display, ligatures, and more
Headless mode (@xterm/headless) for server-side terminal state tracking in Node.js
Zero production dependencies — lightweight and self-contained
Accessibility support with screen reader mode and minimum contrast ratio enforcement
Kitty keyboard protocol, win32-input-mode, and other modern VT extension support
publicApiSurface: Terminal (class) — main entry point: open, write, writeln, resize, loadAddon, dispose
Terminal.buffer — IBufferNamespace for reading terminal buffer state
Terminal.parser — IParser for registering custom escape sequence handlers
Terminal.unicode — IUnicodeHandling for Unicode version management
Terminal events — onData, onKey, onResize, onScroll, onTitleChange, onRender, onBell
Terminal.registerMarker / registerDecoration — line markers and custom decorations
Terminal.registerLinkProvider — custom link detection and interaction
ITerminalAddon — interface for building addons (activate / dispose)
FitAddon — fit terminal to container element (@xterm/addon-fit)
SearchAddon — findNext / findPrevious with decoration highlights (@xterm/addon-search)
AttachAddon — WebSocket attachment to a remote PTY (@xterm/addon-attach)
SerializeAddon — serialize buffer to VT sequences or HTML (@xterm/addon-serialize)
WebLinksAddon — automatic URL detection and interaction (@xterm/addon-web-links)
@xterm/headless — Node.js headless terminal for server-side state tracking
